how_to_apply: MAHA Metro Recruitment 2026 does not use an online application portal. Candidates must fill the physical Application Format (Annexure-I) in bold English capital letters, in their own handwriting, and send it by Speed Post.
Download or note the Application Format (Annexure-I) from the official notification.
Fill in personal, educational, and experience details in bold English capital letters by hand.
Paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph in the space provided.
Attach self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, experience/ office-order certificates, caste certificate (if applicable), and NOC from the current employer (if applicable).
Pay the applicable application fee by Demand Draft (payable at Nagpur) or online via UPI/ BHIM, and attach proof of payment.
Seal the envelope and superscribe it with the Post Name and Advertisement Number (MAHA Metro/ N/ HR/ 05/ 2026).
Send the completed application by Speed Post so that it reaches the address below on or before 25.09.2026:
General Manager (HR) Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Ltd. Metro Bhawan, Near Dikshabhoomi, Nagpur – 440 010

Candidates who are currently employed with Government organizations/ PSUs must forward their application through proper channel, or submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview. Applications received after the closing date, or that are incomplete, will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: MAHA Metro Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Vacancies are announced separately for the Nagpur Metro Rail Project and the Pune Metro Rail Project, with category-wise breakup as given in the notification. Note that MAHA Metro has stated the vacancy numbers are provisional and may increase, decrease, or become nil for any post or category. UR = Unreserved, SC = Scheduled Caste, ST = Scheduled Tribe, OBC = Other Backward Class, PwBD = Person with Benchmark Disability.

content_sections.heading: MAHA Metro Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: MAHA Metro Recruitment 2026 is open only to experienced candidates of Indian Nationality currently working in Metro Rail/ Railway/ Railway PSUs/ Government Organizations/ PSUs/ Metro Related Infrastructure Industries. Applicants must also be residents of Maharashtra State and possess a domicile certificate issued by the competent authority. Educational qualification and minimum experience required differ by post, as summarized below. In addition to the base experience, each post requires candidates to meet one of three specific service conditions relating to current pay scale or CTC (IDA Pay Scale for Metro Rail/ Railway PSU employees, CDA Pay Matrix Level for Railways/ Government Organization employees, or a minimum CTC for candidates from Metro-related infrastructure industries). These vary by post; candidates should refer to the full official notification for the exact pay-scale/ CTC threshold applicable to their target post.

content_sections.heading: MAHA Metro Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Written Test (Online or Offline mode) - Total 70 marks, may comprise General Aptitude and Domain Knowledge. For Multi Tasking Staff/ Attendant posts, an Oral Aptitude Test may be conducted instead of an interview. Interview - Total 30 marks, for candidates who qualify the written test as per the merit list; may comprise Experience, Educational Qualification, and Domain Knowledge. Merit List preparation based on combined Written Test and Interview marks. Pre-Medical Examination (PME) of selected candidates as per the merit list, at a MAHA Metro nominated hospital. Issue of Call Letters to candidates found medically fit. The exact schedule and syllabus of the written test will be communicated in advance by MAHA Metro.

faq.question: Q1. What is MAHA-Metro Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MAHA-Metro) for 56 contractual posts, including Junior Engineer, Office Assistant, Technician, and Attendant, for its Nagpur and Pune Metro Rail Projects, under Advt No. MAHA-Metro/N/HR/05/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MAHA-Metro Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 56 vacancies in total - 40 for the Nagpur Metro Rail Project and 16 for the Pune Metro Rail Project. MAHA-Metro has stated these numbers are provisional and may change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MAHA-Metro Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach the specified Nagpur address by 25.09.2026 at 18:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MAHA-Metro Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post - from HSC/SSC for Attendant and MTS-cum-Motor Driver posts, to ITI for Technician posts, a graduate degree for Office Assistant, and a B.E./B.Tech or engineering diploma for Junior Engineer posts. See the qualification table above for full post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MAHA-Metro Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years for Junior Engineer and Technician posts, and 45 years for Senior Office Assistant, Office Assistant, MTS-cum-Motor Driver, and Attendant posts, as on the closing date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MAHA-Metro Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 100/- for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates, and Rs. 400/- for UR/OBC (including Ex-servicemen) candidates, payable by Demand Draft or online via UPI/ BHIM.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for MAHA-Metro Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application portal for this recruitment. Candidates must fill the physical Application Format (Annexure-I) by hand and send it by Speed Post to the General Manager (HR), MAHA-Metro, Nagpur, along with the required documents and fee proof, by 25.09.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MAHA-Metro Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The process includes a Written Test (70 marks), followed by an Interview (30 marks) or Oral Aptitude Test for MTS/Attendant posts, a Pre-Medical Examination, and finally the issue of call letters to medically fit candidates.
